Method of Attack: Malware disguised as fake Adobe Flash Player installers and fake update pop-ups on hijacked or cloned legitimate websites
Installation of mitmdump proxy and trusted certificate to analyze and modify HTTPS traffic
Injection of ads into web pages and malicious scripts into visited sites
Monitoring and altering encrypted traffic including online banking and secure email
Dropping persistent adware payloads with potential to switch to more dangerous malware like ransomware or wipers
Attack Vector: Distribution through fake and malicious Homebrew website
Fake update pop-ups on hijacked domains or clones of legitimate sites
Notarized by Apple's automated notarizing process to bypass Gatekeeper
Indicators of Compromise: Hijacked domains and cloned legitimate sites
